text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 41 syringes of pegfilgrastim 6 mg/0.6 mL with 14.6 days on hand. Corvale General holds 157 syringes combined across two lots with 27.4 days on hand. Supply is limited but not exhausted.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show pegfilgrastim is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. A label for an Amneal product names Kashiv BioSciences, LLC (FEI 3011289655) as the registered manufacturing plant. That plant received a VAI classification on 2024-06-14 (known 2024-08-16) and an OAI classification on 2018-01-26 (known 2018-02-16).

Our position: Current inventory covers roughly two to four weeks at present use rates. No FDA shortage listing exists. Alternative manufacturers are available for purchase but their labels do not name identifiable plants.

Recommended actions:
1. Place orders with Accord BioPharma, Inc. as the primary vendor — buyer approves.
2. Qualify Biocon Biologics Inc. and Coherus Oncology, Inc. as secondary vendors — buyer and P&T chair approve.
3. Monitor daily usage and inventory levels at both campuses — buyer approves.
4. Report any allocation notices or supply disruptions to the committee immediately — buyer approves.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or dose modifications at this time.
